acceptance_basis: The supported profile retains a single SQLite receipt authority and its five existing public mutation APIs across admitted journal schemas 2, 3 and 4.

The parent-held oracle independently reconstructs complete records, request digests, historical receipts, decisions, outbox state, scoped reads and retention outcomes after 184 deterministic process kills.
Nine seeded histories accumulate independently expected state across 108 logical mutations and 36 killed attempts, distinguishing acknowledged, explicitly rejected and uncertain outcomes.
POSIX directory barrier failures propagate; ownership cleanup always attempts descriptor closure while preserving the primary failure, and failures after publication are not called rollback.
Selected profile admission verifies WAL mode without silent conversion and requires a linked SQLite release containing the documented WAL-reset fix before authority access.
Backup captures committed WAL through SQLite backup, verifies complete retained history, and restores only to a separate new destination protected by an incomplete marker.
Marker-first private reservation removes the empty-visible-destination gap. Sealed verification rejects unexpected sidecars, mismatched hashes, corrupt history and semantic manifest mismatches.
Externally retained receipt comparison detects tested stale, foreign and altered acknowledgements; documentation explicitly excludes freshness proofs without complete independent evidence.

The actual evidence plugin binds source/runtime/filesystem and per-case outcomes to JUnit, rejects incomplete selections and inappropriate skips, and correctly refuses to qualify the volatile local overlay.
Dedicated CI runs are mandatory for six measured platform combinations and all fifteen actual bounded-ext4 ENOSPC cases; local capability skips cannot satisfy them.

Historical focused, plugin and full regression evidence remains attributed to initial source 8037ba2. Correction-specific independent bootstrap tests and source review pass, runtime sources are unchanged, and exact-source environment qualification is still mandatory.

macOS CI selects Homebrew CPython of the requested minor in a disposable virtual environment. The bootstrap verifies the actual interpreter minor and SQL runtime, records the _sqlite3 origin, and rejects an unpatched static or ambiguous macOS SQLite dependency instead of pretending a dylib replacement took effect.

The physical-volume fixture requires physical block allocation exhaustion, zero available blocks and an independently unallocatable empty inode while retaining both file descriptors through the SQLite mutation. Its original SQLITE_FULL, unchanged-authority and exact retry/replay checks remain intact.

limits_and_non_claims: No physical power-loss, controller cache, arbitrary device fault, whole-filesystem-family or production readiness certification.
The local overlay has fsync=volatile and is explicitly not an accepted target filesystem despite passing software tests.
The new 184-case interruption matrix exercises actual Python APIs and a subprocess acknowledgement channel, not real HTTP disconnect timing or every CPU instruction.
A consistent older authority or lost committed WAL cannot always be identified without separately retained acknowledged receipts and original requests.
Receipt comparison attests only supplied receipts; a missing, empty or incomplete client ledger cannot establish completeness.
Restore recovers the captured revision, never merges divergent histories, performs cutover, or recovers newer acknowledged commits by itself.
Checksums and source-ID reporting do not attest authenticity against hostile filesystem writers, malicious in-process code or custom libraries that forge identities.
Network/shared filesystems, multi-host ownership, noncooperating writers and experimental persistence/component paths remain excluded.
Physical erasure, persisted-family migration qualification, mixed-operation concurrency qualification, live-agent outcomes and release promotion remain separate outstanding scope.
Focused, plugin, full-suite and future CI selections overlap and must not be added into one aggregate test count.
The successful initial Linux and Windows artifacts do not qualify corrected source or the untested Homebrew macOS distributions.
The revised physical ENOSPC precondition has local control-flow review only until dedicated actual-volume CI passes; fifteen local capability skips provide no physical qualification.
The 4048-pass full suite and 450-case actual plugin integration are historical initial-source results; only the 44-case correction-specific unit selection was rerun independently.

milestone.name: Qualify crash recovery and supported filesystems

required_remaining_qualification: All six profile-recovery jobs on Ubuntu/macOS/Windows and CPython 3.10/3.13 must pass on the exact published source.

Downloaded real runner evidence must report accepted=true, the actual supported local filesystem and linked SQLite identity, with matching JUnit digest and complete passing matrix; Windows permits only the fifteen inapplicable directory-barrier parameter cases.
The dedicated bounded 128 MiB ext4 job must report fifteen passing actual filesystem-full cases, zero skips and zero failures/errors; logical SQLite quota and local skips are not substitutes.
All seventeen workflow jobs must pass; source tree/PR merge attribution must be verified and PR #118 must remain unmerged.
resolved_review_findings: POSIX directory-open errors had been silently ignored by the directory durability barrier; they now propagate after visible publication.
Diagnostic cleanup or explicit unlock failure could prevent final descriptor closure; cleanup now attempts every release step and preserves the primary error.
Previously selected existing authorities were not required to remain in WAL mode; strict profile admission and live connections now reject mode drift.

Official SQLite WAL-reset corruption exposure cannot be excluded by existing writer ownership because pre-lock read connections may checkpoint on close; patched runtime admission and real CI runtime provisioning were added.
Immutable SQLite reports journal_mode=delete even for a sealed WAL-format file; sealed verification now checks the actual database header and absence of journal sidecar dependence.

Writing the incomplete marker after creating the requested destination exposed a fresh empty directory on failure; a marker-first private directory is now published atomically under a cooperating publisher lock.
Python dictionary equality accepted boolean aliases for manifest integer claims; canonical JSON authority comparison now distinguishes their types.

Evidence recording now includes dirty-tree attribution, actual test directory/device verification, minimum matrix coverage, positive coverage from each required module, precise skip rules and a mandatory JUnit report.
Conflicting deepest Linux mount observations reject unless the actual device identifies the mount; arbitrary runner labels and unmeasured filesystems do not qualify.
Documentation distinguishes Python/subprocess acknowledgement interruption from untested HTTP transport loss and directs corrupt-source recovery to an earlier separately verified backup.

CI 318 macOS setup used a Python distribution with statically embedded SQLite, so DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH did not replace the active runtime. CI now selects same-minor Homebrew CPython and verifies the actual executable/minor/SQLite identity; unsupported static or ambiguous replacement fails explicitly.

CI 318 obtained ENOSPC from a large filler write without establishing zero remaining allocation capacity, and all fifteen later SQLite mutations still succeeded. The fixture now physically allocates block tails, verifies zero available blocks and an independent one-block allocation failure, retains descriptors through SQLite, and reports sanitized allocation telemetry.
